name: Godot
description: Start 2D or 3D games with the Godot editor.

engine.name: Godot
engine.description: A light, free editor with GDScript. Exports to desktop, mobile and the web.

requires.label: Godot
requires.help: The project is made without it, but you need the Godot editor to run and edit the game.

engine.run: Open project.godot in Godot, then press Play (F5).

web.note: exports to the web, with a larger download

mobile.note: native mobile apps, without a web view's frame cap

consoles.note: consoles only through a porting company

code.note: scenes are text files the agent can edit
